benign_quality_screen.limitation: Automated labels are estimates without independent human validation.

dataset_limitations: Lexical screening does not establish semantic or pretraining independence.
Size and source composition both change; this is an expansion experiment, not an isolated sample-size experiment.
Existing baseline overlap with newly reserved benchmark sources is not retroactively removed.
Source labels are inherited; new benign examples require a separate quality screen before calibration.
No performance or universal-refusal-removal claim follows from dataset preparation.
limitations: Fold consistency and validation AUROC are diagnostics, not proof of reduced refusals or preserved capabilities.
The validation prompts are historical selection data, not new confirmation data.
The expansion changes size and source composition together.
Data overlap screening is lexical; semantic/pretraining contamination remains unverified.
overlap_rule: Normalized exact, any shared word 8-gram, or word-3gram Jaccard >= 0.5 against existing splits, reserved benchmarks, prior pilot inputs and earlier accepted additions.
scope: Direction estimation, four-fold consistency and fixed validation separation only; no weight edit or refusal/capability test.

settings.precision: bf16 model, fp32 cached slices, fp64 accumulated sums
